title: Introduce credential watermarking, per-operator KMS governor, and consolidated residency audit
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: customers operating in regulated jurisdictions asked for stronger operator-level accountability and a way to prove which operator actions triggered KMS usage without leaking sensitive key material. This change introduces three coordinated pieces: 1) credential watermarking for operator-issued API tokens (non-secret stamp embedded in token metadata and audit-trace), 2) a per-operator KMS governor that enforces soft quotas and emits KMS usage provenance headers for downstream audit, and 3) a consolidated residency audit pipeline that stitches RBAC v2 decisions, KMS provenance, and region pin metadata into a single exportable audit artifact. Motivation: improves non-repudiation, makes post-incident forensic queries simpler, and helps meet regulatory audit requests without adding operator-visible latency. Changes: - credential watermarking: new token issuance flow adds a deterministic watermark id (HMAC over operator id + issuance ts, keyed with deployment-local secret) stored as token metadata and emitted as x-operator-watermark in internal audit messages only. Token payloads are unchanged for customers; watermark is only present in internal audit and ephemeral logs. - per-operator KMS governor: lightweight middleware in pkg/kms/governor that tracks per-operator KMS call rates (local cache + distributed counters fallback) and enforces configurable soft thresholds; when thresholds hit, metrics and audit events are emitted and optional throttling can be enabled per-tenant. - residency audit consolidation: new audit exporter (cmd/audit-exporter/residency-consolidator) that consumes rbac-decision-stream, kms-provenance stream, and region-assertion events and writes canonical residency-audit objects for compliance ingestion. Migration/compatibility: new features are opt-in via config flags (feature.credential_watermark, feature.kms_governor, audit.residency_consolidation). Default off for existing clusters. Security considerations: watermark key is stored in KMS-wrapped secret and rotated monthly; watermark values are one-way HMACs to prevent reverse engineering of operator ids. Audit artifacts are TTL'd and can be configured to redact sensitive fields before export. Tests & rollout: unit + e2e tests added; staged rollout plan uses a shadow-mode where the governor only observes for two weeks before optional enforcement. Linear tasks: ENG-1298 broken into incremental work items for rollout. Checklist: - [x] design review (SEC-442) - [x] unit tests - [x] e2e shadow-mode test - [x] integration with audit exporter - [x] docs and runbook updates - [x] staged rollout notes (canary then global)
commit_summary: Initial implementation of watermark generator and token metadata plumbing
Add KMS governor middleware and per-operator counter store with Redis fallback
Implement residency-audit consolidator and streaming ingest adapters
Add unit tests, e2e shadow-mode harness, and docs/runbook updates
Address reviewer feedback: make watermark HMAC key KMS-wrapped and add redaction hooks
review_comments: Daniel Ortiz: Nice direction. Request: make watermark HMAC key KMS-wrapped; don't rely on plaintext config in-cluster. Also can we ensure the watermark is not returned to customer-facing logs?
Maya Chen (author): Agree, switched to KMS-wrapped key and added a code path that strips watermark headers before any response written to public logs. Added unit test verifying header redaction.
Priya Nair: KMS governor looks good. Two requests: 1) add metrics histogram for time-to-enforce and 2) document the failure modes when counter store is unavailable.
Maya Chen: Added prometheus histogram and fallback doc section; governor runs in observe-only mode when counter store is degraded by default.
Greg Shah: Audit consolidator needs stable canonical schema. Please add schema versioning and a migration path.
Maya Chen: Added schema.v field and versioned exporter config; wrote migration helper to synthesize v1 artifacts from older audit fragments.
ci_checks: integration-tests: initially failed (timing flaky), rerun -> pass
release_notes: Add opt-in credential watermarking for operator tokens, a per-operator KMS governor (observe then enforce), and a residency audit consolidator. Opt-in via feature flags; see docs/security/credential-watermarking.md and docs/runbooks/kms-governor-canary.md for rollout guidance.
